data.summary: The independent validation report for CR-001 (CR-001 Retail PD Scorecard) has been completed with an overall rating of Not fit for use. Key findings include Input stability train → oot (CSI) — `status.of.existing.checking.account` (red), Input stability train → oot (CSI) — `credit.history` (red), Input stability train → oot (CSI) — `purpose` (red), and Input stability train → oot (CSI) — `savings.account.and.bonds` (red). Additionally, Input stability train → oot (CSI) — `present.employment.since` received an amber status, while Favourable-outcome parity across groups (disparate impact) — `age_band` also received an amber status. The model's overall performance is compromised due to multiple red statuses in critical input stability checks.
